intro: Venezuela has the world's largest proven oil reserves, but its economy shrank dramatically.

chapters.title: Oil
text: Most reserves are heavy oil in the Orinoco Belt. Output fell sharply due to mismanagement and sanctions. Inflation reached millions of per cent around 2018.

chapters.title: Other resources
text: Venezuela also has gold, iron ore and cocoa, prized by chocolate makers.
